APPROVED_SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENT_CONT.objective: Complete the reliability hardening of the embedded database under /app/stonevault while preserving the documented native compatibility contracts.
material_requirements: exclusive writer ownership with clean release
explicit data-dir precedence over environment and default
transaction-lifetime MVCC snapshots with own-write/delete overlay
raw-byte prefix scans in deterministic unsigned bytewise order
first-committer-wins conflict rejection without sequence consumption
atomic durable commits with contiguous increasing sequences
rollback and killed-open-transaction WAL invisibility after restart
retain valid committed transactions, discard only torn final WAL tails, fail closed on complete-record or committed-history corruption
checkpoint quiescence, atomic snapshot publication, durable sequence/rows and zero-byte WAL reclamation
reject corrupt snapshots while only ignoring/removing abandoned snapshot.tmp
accurate STATS and HEALTH durable/runtime state
binary hex representation and inclusive key/prefix/value limits
malformed command and unknown transaction ERR resilience
preserve documented C ABI, ASCII responses, WAL/snapshot layouts and existing data compatibility

avoid: task details copied from unrelated calibration domains
must_preserve: writer fencing, data-dir precedence, MVCC snapshot/overlay, FCW conflicts, durable contiguous commits, WAL recovery, checkpoint/snapshot integrity, STATS/HEALTH, binary protocol limits, stable native compatibility
structure: state the approved engineering objective first
preserve exact public contracts and hard safety/state constraints
reference solver-visible technical contracts instead of reproducing hidden verifier rows

REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.locking_and_configuration: writer fencing and data-directory precedence are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.mvcc_and_conflicts: stable transaction snapshots, own overlays, bytewise scans, FCW rejection and sequence semantics are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.durability_and_recovery: atomic durable commits, rollback/crash invisibility, WAL torn-tail versus complete-corruption behavior and contiguous sequencing are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.checkpoint_and_snapshot: quiescence, atomic publication, WAL reclamation, snapshot validation and abandoned temporary handling are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.operator_and_protocol: STATS/HEALTH, binary hex behavior, inclusive limits and malformed-input resilience are explicit
REQUIREMENT_COVERAGE.compatibility: C ABI, ASCII responses, WAL/snapshot layouts and existing data compatibility are explicit
